name: com.freekickclassics.duellink
description: Transport-agnostic link between two phones for turn-based duels: the IDuelLink interface, wire messages that each fit one 20-byte BLE write, commit-reveal for secret picks, room advertisement UUIDs and a round-trip-time probe. Pure C#, no UnityEngine dependency, so Dunk Duel and Volley Duel can reuse it.
